msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia el-armario-de-reme-31.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a khaki overshirt jacket with matching wide-leg trousers and a white top from the reference, walking at the Paseo de la Independencia in Zaragoza, Spain, with its arcades and autumn trees, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia el-armario-de-reme-31.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a khaki overshirt jacket with matching wide-leg trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia el-armario-de-reme-26.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a brown sweatshirt layered over a light blue shirt with brown wide-leg trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia el-armario-de-reme-37.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a pastel pink and blue check blouse with a ruffled collar and ruffled trims from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia el-armario-de-reme-36.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a pale yellow knit waistcoat with small gold studs over a white shirt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
